wolfram.note: The symbolic-agreement probe (#342) tries FullSimplify on a numeric DIFFERENCE of the two sides, which only makes sense for a scalar -- a Graph isn't one, so -Graph[...] and N[-Graph[...]] are themselves meaningless and the probe can't come back anything but Indeterminate.
